_comment: D0 diagnostic arm: internal-dynamics gate probe on the 1M backbone. Adds target_latent_hf_subband fusion head ONLY to measure gate_delta/rho; NOT a comparison arm. Stops after 3 epochs-worth of updates (93 steps) so the probe fires twice.

ablation.name: D0_gate_probe
ablation.notes: Diagnostic-only: enables target_latent_hf_subband fusion head (encoder+proj+delta LH/HL) to produce real gate_delta / rho readings. Changes parameter count and HF velocity routing, so it must never be compared against A0-A3 as a training arm.
